description: This file exports constants and a module object containing functions and classes related to graph processing, including a Queue class, graph layout algorithms, and various utility functions for graph manipulation.

classes.name: f
classes.description: A Queue class implementing enqueue, dequeue, and toString methods for managing nodes.

methods.name: dequeue
methods.description: Removes and returns the last element from the queue.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Adds an element to the queue.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the queue.
